answer: A sybil-resistant economy can use a lantern each agent must keep lit: it proves work each epoch, countersigned by two peers. Standing grows only while the lantern burns without a gap, and a haven registry admits only agents with unbroken histories. New identities start dark and must earn light over time, so an attacker running a thousand fake lanterns must produce a thousand streams of peer-checked work each epoch, plus a bond per identity slashed when its lantern lapses; even a ledge outage needs a peer-signed note, so honest downtime is forgiven but mass fakery costs as much as honest work.
